Riley Brown@rileybrown · Nov 14

A 2-minute 4K film made entirely in Blender from one prompt on Fable 5.2, about 4.5 hours of work (1,457 likes).

The Fable of Clawd

A 2 minute 4K film made entirely in Blender, from one prompt on Fable 5.2. It took about 4.5 hours.

Claude built every asset in Blender by writing Python:
- 5 characters and props: Clawd, his friend Pip, a toy truck, a 3D-printed tulip and a gift box
- 7 full sets: a study, a staircase, a street, a workshop, an airport, a night sky and a house
- every camera move and every frame of animation across 52 shots

That came to 12,500 lines of code. It started 7 copies of itself to build the sets at the same time.

Then it rented 89 GPUs through RunPod to render 3,220 frames as fast as possible, 36 of them running at once. Total cost: a little over $20.

My biggest takeaway is my Claude Code knows it has access to cloud compute, so it's much more ambitious.

I tried a similar prompt on my other computer that doesn't have the runpod skill setup and it wasn't nearly as high quality

Full details linked below.

claude fable 5.2 is f*cking insane for video editing

i'm in a cafe pouring tea, and my laptop is cutting my next video by itself. the timeline you see filling up on the screen is claude code putting the clips together while my hands are busy with the teapot

editing used to eat my evenings. now all the raw footage goes into one folder and i write one message about how the video should feel. fable 5.2 picks the best takes and cuts out the pauses. by the time the tea is gone there's a draft waiting on my phone

my setup:

1. drop every raw clip into one folder
2. open claude code in that folder and switch to fable 5.2
3. describe the mood and the length in one message
4. go drink something and check the draft on your phone

one person now ships videos like a small studio. the editing runs in the background and my time goes into ideas and filming

EnvolDev video: same film prompt run on Fable 5.2, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra; Hydrogen cost $6.21 but was the least good (203 likes).

Fable 5.2 vs Gemini 4 Hydrogen vs Opus 5.5 vs GPT-6 Astra ☁️

Gemini 4 Hydrogen made the whole film for $6.21. 🤯
But it's the least good of all. 😬

Same prompt: Rio Above the Clouds
Opus 5.5: $60.89 · 2h 19m 35s
Fable 5.2: $76.04 · 1h 59m 11s
Gemini 4 Hydrogen: $6.21 · 1h 33m 48s
GPT-6 Astra: $16.89 · 34m 06s

And this time it ran on Extra High. In my last test, it could only run on High. So no excuses.

I know I can't compare it to frontier models like Fable 5.2 or Opus 5.5.
But the result was not good at all.

GPT-6 Astra cost only $10.68 more, finished almost 1 hour faster, and made a better film.

I'm not impressed at all by Hydrogen on this one. 🤦

What do you guys think? 👀
